title: Evolutionary and Ecological Bioinformatics
requiresNote: COMP 212 or COMP 312, or one of several biology courses (BIOL 181, 182, 195, 205, 206, 207 or 225).
summary: Algorithms for phylogeny, sequence alignment and genome analysis, team-taught by an evolutionary biologist and a computer scientist. Cross-listed as BIOL 327.
take: Build the algorithms that will solve the major medical issues of our time by constantly searching google for simple python commands.
